manifest_file_integrity.method: Each manifest path was read as bytes; actual SHA-256 and byte length were compared with the immutable review_input_v2.json declaration before content review.

reviewer_independence.method: Reviewed the immutable candidate directly from all five full-resolution PNG renders, contact sheet, five-page PDF, PPTX extracted frontstage text and speaker notes, teaching master, both student materials, rehearsal script, data snapshot and internal repair record. The internal record was treated only as evidence of intended fixes, not as a release decision.
reviewer_independence.write_scope: Only this review JSON was created. No teaching source, PPTX, PDF, render, student material or package file was modified.

counting_rule: Counts represent distinct issue classes, not every repeated page occurrence. Any P0, P1 or P2 is release-blocking under the declared gate.

C101.unique_visual_duty: Let the complete first chapter enter before close reading and support student identification of who performs each action.
C101.first_glance: The complete five-line original occupies the dominant central field. The two action-marking prompts are secondary and color-separated; no gloss, chapter summary, character label or later fact is shown.
evidence: slide-1.png shows all five original lines at 31 pt inside the largest high-contrast field.
The foreground asks only to circle his actions, underline her actions, identify the actor and leave a question mark for unknown words.
03A contains the same complete original and open marking task without gloss or answer.
Notes and rehearsal script postpone word meanings to C102-C104 and constrain peer feedback to action-subject checking.

visual_qa.original_text_readability: Desktop pass: 31 pt, strong dark-on-warm-paper contrast and ample line spacing.

C101.graphic_function: Color dots and prompt colors encode the two actor-marking operations; the large unmarked poem preserves initial uncertainty.
C101.adjacent_merge_test: Deletion or merging into C102 would expose only the first two lines and narrow attention to the trade/proposal turn before students have received the chapter as a whole. The stated deletion loss is credible.
C101.script_picture_consistency: Consistent: the picture supplies a complete uncolored text and the script explicitly avoids projecting completed action colors.
C101.remaining_P3: Verify from the last row that the 19.5-23 pt lower instructions are readable without teacher repetition and that students can finish actor marking despite unresolved vocabulary.

C102.unique_visual_duty: Expose the narrative turn from the visible trade action to the woman's disclosed proposal purpose while preserving the boundary against retrospective character judgment.
C102.first_glance: The two source lines remain dominant at 39 pt. Three questions guide visible action, later disclosure and the turning word without displaying a paraphrase, highlighted answer or character illustration.
evidence: slide-2.png places both lines in one central frame, allowing the repeated '贸丝' and '匪' to remain in the same visual field.
The three lower cards are questions only; they do not print '匪', '谋婚', '欺骗' or a modern translation.
03B asks for the student's natural paraphrase and turning word before teacher calibration.
Notes delay six glosses until after individual writing and prohibit turning the entrance impression into a completed personality verdict.

visual_qa.original_text_readability: Desktop pass: 39 pt light text on dark background.

C102.graphic_function: The single original-text field maintains line-to-line comparison; the three cards correspond to the sequence of observation, disclosure and locating textual turn.
C102.adjacent_merge_test: C102 could not absorb C103 without losing C103's physical/spatial action. C102's own two old line pages have already been validly merged. Deletion would remove the explicit textual turn and evidence-boundary work.
C102.script_picture_consistency: Consistent: no gloss or answer appears on the picture before the scripted student paraphrase.
C102.remaining_P3: Observe whether students actually discover '匪' from the two lines or merely infer it from the third prompt, and whether the three equal cards diffuse attention away from the repeated original words.

C103.unique_visual_duty: Turn '送-涉-至' into a continuous spatial action rather than a flat place-name translation.
C103.first_glance: The source line is highly prominent and the three verbs occupy separated positions with no completed arrows, map, emotional label or character image.
evidence: slide-3.png uses three large 49 pt verbs spaced across the page; the spacing is the manipulable visual object.
The earlier decorative curves recorded in internal_visual_qa_v1.md are absent from the full-resolution V2 render.
03B provides the same three words and blank space for a student-created line; it explicitly forbids invented geographic detail.
The script requires finger movement, student pen trace, natural-language reconstruction and return to the original line.

visual_qa.original_text_readability: Desktop pass: original line 44 pt bold; three target verbs 49 pt bold.

C103.graphic_function: The separated circles provide positions for a student-generated spatial connection. They carry the literary action sequence rather than decorate a completed illustration.
C103.adjacent_merge_test: The physical and pen-trace channel is materially different from C102's narrative turn and C104's speech-act listening. Deleting or merging it would plausibly reduce '送-涉-至' to a flat paraphrase.
C103.script_picture_consistency: Consistent: both picture and script withhold arrows, direction, distance and exact map facts.

C104.unique_visual_duty: Have students construct the two lines as one speech turn and identify how explanation, appeasement and appointment of a date move the marriage forward while retaining the boundary around '无怒'.
C104.first_glance: The original remains readable, but the three large colored cards already name the exact interpretive speech acts: '解释', '安抚' and '定了下来'. These are not neutral locating prompts; they are the page's declared three-layer literary conclusion.
evidence: slide-4.png foreground prints '她先解释什么？又在安抚什么？最后，把什么定了下来？'.
The teaching master defines the unique learning change as reading out the three layers '解释、安抚、约期'.
03B repeats the same three pre-categorized questions before student generation.
The script says students should generate the three-layer speech action before teacher calibration, but both PPT and handout supply two complete layer labels and the third action label in advance.
In the full-resolution render, the bottom instruction wraps so that the final character and punctuation '清。' sit alone on a new line, weakening scanability of the listener protocol.

visual_qa.original_text_readability: Desktop pass: both original lines are 38 pt with strong contrast.
visual_qa.instruction_layout: Release-blocking P2: awkward terminal orphan '清。' in the bottom listener instruction.

C104.answer_or_later_fact_frontstage: Partial completed answer: no later marriage fact is exposed, but the interpretive categories that constitute the page's core literary learning are front-loaded before students listen and name the actions.
C104.graphic_function: The three cards are functionally tied to the speech layers, but because they display the layer names rather than receive student language, the graphic becomes a precompleted classification scaffold.
C104.adjacent_merge_test: Its two source lines appropriately belong together and should not be split. The need for a distinct dialogue/listening page is credible, but that does not validate the present answer-bearing foreground.
C104.script_picture_consistency: Contradictory at the key generation point: the script claims student generation before calibration, while foreground and 03B pre-name the intended three speech actions.

findings.issue: Core interpretive answer categories are supplied before student generation.
findings.release_impact: Students can complete objects under teacher-provided labels without themselves discovering how the utterance acts; the visible artifact cannot prove the stated unique learning change.
findings.required_disposition: Reframe the first-pass prompt and 03B fields so students first say or mark what each clause is doing in their own language; introduce '解释/安抚/约期' only after hearing student versions, or explicitly redefine the unique function as object-filling rather than speech-act generation.

findings.issue: Bottom listener instruction has an isolated terminal '清。' line in the full-resolution render.
findings.release_impact: The protocol becomes visually noisy at the precise point where one-pass comprehension of the listener role is required.
findings.required_disposition: Shorten or resize/reflow the listener instruction and re-render so the sentence resolves in one or two balanced lines without an orphan.

C104.remaining_P3: After revision, test whether peers can distinguish a genuinely unheard meaning layer from generic comments about expressive reading.

C105.unique_visual_duty: Remove local supports after complete rereading, test whether students can reconstruct the chapter as a continuous story, and seed the first cell of the growing six-chapter story rail.
C105.first_glance: Before blackout, the complete original at 29 pt and the three story prompts make the intended rereading and later retrieval structure clear. The six-chapter rail is visible but intentionally empty beyond chapter one.
evidence: slide-5.png correctly shows the complete chapter for rereading and the script explicitly calls for pressing B after rereading.
PowerPoint speaker notes, teaching master and rehearsal script all include the B-key blackout, so the projector-side repair is real rather than merely asserted in the internal repair record.
CH1-A/03A, distributed at C101 and retained as an evidence artifact, contains the complete first-chapter original.
At C105 the teacher says only '把细读单暂时扣在桌面上' and later '把书合上'; stage directions likewise say '学生扣住细读单并合书旁白'. They never instruct students to turn over, collect, close or otherwise remove CH1-A/03A.
The scene nevertheless claims students work after '真正撤去投影和纸面支架'. That claim is not guaranteed by the written classroom action because one complete-original paper support remains unaddressed.

After B-key blackout the projected prompt also disappears; therefore the procedure depends entirely on oral recall of the three prompts, which is acceptable only if all paper supports are deliberately controlled.

visual_qa.original_text_readability: Desktop pass: 29 pt source text, above the stated 28 pt core-original threshold.
visual_qa.story_rail_readability: P3: inactive chapter numerals and lines are very subdued at 14 pt/low contrast; verify they remain recognizable as a growing six-part rail in the classroom.

C105.graphic_function: The two-column text-to-story layout and six-part bottom rail are tied to rereading, retrieval and future chapter accumulation. They are not merely decorative.
C105.adjacent_merge_test: The reread, blackout retrieval, peer gap check and first story-rail entry form one coherent assessment event. Deleting C105 would leave C102-C104 as disconnected local work; merging it back into C104 would remove the required change in evidence state.
C105.script_picture_consistency: Projector behavior is consistent, but the complete classroom script is inconsistent with its own claim that paper supports have been removed.

findings.issue: B-key blackout removes the projected original but does not reliably remove all paper copies of the original; CH1-A/03A remains uncontrolled.
findings.release_impact: A student can read the full chapter from CH1-A during the purported closed-book retelling. The resulting performance cannot be interpreted as genuine retrieval, so the page's unique assessment function and evidence claim fail.
findings.required_disposition: The executable script and stage directions must explicitly account for both CH1-A and CH1-B before blackout, for example by collecting or turning over both named sheets, then re-render/rebuild the frozen package and re-review the immutable candidate.

C105.remaining_P3: After the paper-support repair, observe whether oral delivery of the three prompts survives the blackout and whether 30 seconds is enough for a natural retelling rather than three label fragments.

global_findings.finding: The five-page sequence has a coherent chapter-level reception chain: complete chapter and actors (C101), proposal-purpose turn (C102), spatial response (C103), marriage dialogue (C104), then whole-story reconstruction and first story-rail cell (C105). C101, C103 and C105 have credible deletion losses, and the old excessive fragmentation has materially been reduced.

The five pages are not fatally homogeneous. Whole-poem field, question comparison, spatial verb positions, dialogue layers and story-rail retrieval use different graphic organizations, while the warm-paper/dark alternation preserves family resemblance. C102 and C104 both use three lower elements, but they do not create a release-blocking five-page template loop.

Across the five full-resolution PNGs, contact sheet and PDF, no overlap, clipping, text overflow, missing glyph, leftover placeholder or low-contrast core original was found. Original text sizes are C101 31 pt, C102 39 pt, C103 44 pt, C104 38 pt and C105 29 pt.

No later marriage event or completed chapter summary appears on the five PPT pages. However, C104 violates the more specific generation-before-calibration boundary by pre-naming the page's central three speech-act interpretations.
The projector blackout repair is present in notes and executable script, but retrieval validity remains unproven because the earlier complete-original CH1-A sheet is never explicitly removed.

release_gate.declared_rule: P0=0 and P1=0 and P2=0 in both independent reviews
minimum_reentry_conditions: Remove C104's answer-bearing first-pass speech-act labels from both frontstage and the pre-distributed CH1-B generation fields, or revise the claimed function and evidence contract so they match what students actually generate.
Fix the C104 orphaned listener-instruction line and verify a fresh full-resolution render.
Make C105 explicitly withdraw both named student sheets containing original text before B-key blackout and closed-book narration.
Regenerate every dependent artifact, issue a new immutable review manifest with new hashes and bytes, and obtain fresh independent visual and student-reception reviews.

claim_boundary.review_claim: This is a desktop review of the exact immutable V2 package and its scripted classroom behavior. It can reject contradictions and ungrounded evidence claims, but it does not establish actual student learning, timing or projection performance.
not_claimed: No claim that real students have completed, understood or retained the lesson.
No claim that B-key blackout and material control have been observed in a live classroom.
No claim that last-row readability, 27-minute pacing or peer-listening quality has been empirically validated.
remaining_P3_observations_after_all_bloc: Last-row readability of C101 and C104 lower instructions and the subdued C105 story rail.
Whether C102 prompts permit genuine discovery of '匪' rather than cue-driven guessing.
Whether C104 listeners can name an actually unheard meaning layer and whether C105 blackout narration remains coherent under the 30-second limit.
